day_shape: Two same-day State Dept sanctions rounds targeting Iran's crypto exchanges and cash pipelines, US officials signal imminent Iran-Oman Hormuz deal, Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defence pact signed in Mecca, CENTCOM reports 51 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, heavy regime Journalists' Day messaging.

threads.label: US sanctions and Hormuz deal signals
threads.summary: The State Department announced two sanctions actions targeting Iranian digital asset exchanges and a UAE-based currency network moving hundreds of millions for Iranian elites. US officials told Jerusalem Post and Iran International a Hormuz-related Iran-Oman deal could be announced within days, while CENTCOM said it had redirected 51 commercial vessels as of 7 August.

threads.label: Mecca defence pact and regime reaction
threads.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a trilateral defence pact in Mecca, with Pakistan's defence minister framing it as an Islamic-world response to Israel. Iranian officials and Yemen's Al-Mashat mocked the agreement, and Defa Press cited Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri dismissing US claims over Iranian oil.

threads.label: Regime Journalists' Day messaging cycle
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a heavy 17 Mordad Journalists' Day cycle featuring greetings from Speaker Qalibaf and Judiciary head Mohseni Ejei, alongside Defence Ministry statements framing journalism as national deterrence. Defa Press and IRIB also amplified Reuters and CNN pieces portraying Trump as seeking an exit from the war with Iran.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon incidents and Hezbollah disarmament talks
threads.summary: Times of Israel's Manni Fabian reported a Hezbollah explosive drone struck near IDF forces at Ali Taher Ridge with no casualties, an incident IRIB also covered from the Lebanese side. Jerusalem Post reported Israel and Lebanon agreed on a shortlist of countries to verify Hezbollah disarmament under a US-brokered framework.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and post-war economy
threads.summary: Iran International reported hardliners pushing a renewed hijab crackdown, dozens of January-protest detainees held without hearings per HRANA, and analysts describing post-war economic strain on regime institutions. President Pezeshkian, quoted by Defa Press, said Iran made no concessions in the agreement and did not initiate the war.

events.title_en: Efficient governance is a public right of the nation
events.summary_en: An excerpt from the message of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution: Realising the nation's rights is not limited to individual matters alone, and all manner of public and social rights of the people—from the right to economic security and fair access to opportunities to the right to fairly share in natural blessings, a healthy environment, legitimate freedoms, and efficient governance—are considered important matters in advancing justice. 7 Tir 1405. Mostour is a textual compilation that reviews and revisits passages from the messages and texts of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution.

events.title: Dozens of Iran protest detainees held without hearings - rights group
events.summary: Dozens of people detained over Iran's January protests remain in a security ward in the country's northwest, with more than half still awaiting hearings or serving prison sentences of up to five years, the US-based Human Rights Activists News Agency (HRANA) reported on Friday.

events.title: A Palestinian terrorist who invaded Israel during the October 7, 2023 onslaught was captured by the IDF earlier this week while working as a truck driver who arrived in the Israeli-held portion of the Gaza Strip to collect goods, according to security sources. The member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force had requested a permit to deliver private sector goods inside the Strip, and was granted one by the Shin Bet security agency. Upon arriving at the Gazan side of the Kerem Shalom Crossing on Wednesday to collect the goods, Israeli troops apprehended him, the sources say. He was then taken to be questioned by the Shin Bet.
